title: ctOS design tokens
description: Top-level keys are sections. Each section maps a globally unique camelCase token name to a value, a {reference} to another token, or an object with metadata.

type.description: Override the inferred type. 'easing' takes a Qt Easing name ("OutCubic") and emits Easing.<name>

mutable.description: Emit a writable property instead of readonly

deprecated.description: Token(s) to use instead. Theme.qml marks it and the build warns on every QML use

value.description: Colors are #RGB, #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA (CSS order). '{name}' references another token.
